So conserve on comfortable HP, bid just above David-like pressure when supply is tight, and switch to strong survival bids only when HP/no-water risk becomes urgent.

My strategy adapts to opponent's previous day's highest bid and my current HP. If opponents bid very high and my HP is good, I save. If my HP is low, I bid aggressively to survive. Day 1 or no history uses default competitive bids, prioritizing survival if HP is critical.

Cindy is the primary threat with high spending. Alex is moderate. I will bid aggressively enough to secure water when supply is tight (15-20) while conserving budget by bidding conservatively when supply is high (20-25) and my HP is safe.
